title: Multivariate (bivariate) meta-analysis in the browser: validation against the R packages mvmeta and metafor
description: Validation of the allmeta multivariate-ma page (bivariate REML meta-analysis with unstructured between-study covariance) against R mvmeta 1.0.3 with a metafor 5.2-1 rma.mv cross-check (92 configurations from 22 datasets; original 18591/18684, patched 18682/18682 checks pass, validated at the pull request #154 commit 1b9b9327d752); plus panel 54612/54612 and exported-R-script round trip 29473/29502 under the strict rule, re-executed on allmeta v1.8.0 (tag commit 1cb3f84), DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23515177. Source commit acd363fa33f0decd2fcafcf08814f663bb9d6178 plus fix.patch.
